title: Team composition obligations
description: Governed catalog that derives the obligatory part of a mission team roster from the mission classification, and declares which roles are staffed from mission creation.

roster_headroom.description: How many members a mission team may gain beyond its composed roster (TC-06 restaffing). The lifecycle max_members cap is derived as max(template-declared, roster + headroom), so the cap is a real ceiling rather than a restatement of the roster size.

roster_proposal.description: TC-12: whether a reasoning backend may PROPOSE discretionary roles beyond the derived roster. Off by default — a proposal is only ever a suggestion that must survive the same capability, authority, separation-of-duties and max_members checks as any other staffing decision.

excluded_roles.description: Roles a proposer may never suggest (structural roles are excluded implicitly).

always_staffed_roles.description: Structural roles staffed at mission creation. Every other roster role starts on standby and is staffed on demand.

when.description: Every declared facet must match (AND); within one facet any listed value matches (OR). An empty object matches every mission.
